user.title: LG ThinQ local cloud
user.description: Home Assistant will act as the ThinQ cloud for your LG appliances. The hostname must resolve to this machine through your LAN's regular DNS (not mDNS, not an IP address). During appliance setup, `common.lgthinq.com` must resolve here too.

data.https_advertise_port: HTTPS port appliances connect to (only if forwarded)

data_description.https_port: Appliances look for 443 during setup. If 443 is taken on this machine, listen on another port (e.g. 8443) and forward 443 to it.
data_description.https_advertise_port: Leave empty unless your router forwards this port to the one above. Set to 443 when 443 is forwarded.

error.invalid_hostname: Enter a DNS hostname such as thinq.lan - not an IP address and not a .local name.
error.port_in_use: Could not listen on one of the ports: {error}

init.title: Decoder profile
init.description: Pick which decoder an appliance uses. `auto` matches on the appliance's ThinQ model id; unknown models fall back to `generic`, which only records raw frames.
